sentences.text: Sa Talaiassa -LRB- -LSB- sə təɫəˈjasə -RSB- -RRB- , also known as Sa Talaia or Sa Talaia de Sant Josep , is the highest mountain in the island of Ibiza in the Balearic Islands of Spain .	Ibiza	Ibiza	Balearic Islands	Balearic Islands	Spain	Spain
It is located in the southwest of the island .
Talaia , the name of the mountain , means `` watchtower '' in Catalan , Talaiassa referring to an especially large one .	watchtower	watchtower	Catalan	Catalan language
Sant Josep de sa Talaia , the island 's largest municipality , is named after this mountain .	Sant Josep de sa Talaia	Sant Josep de sa Talaia

causal_questions.question: Sa Talaiassa is the highest mountain on a island.
